## Summary

Describe the problem, the change and its resulting behaviour. Keep the scope
focused and explain material design decisions.

## Related work

Link the relevant issue, contract or Conductor track. Use a closing keyword only
when this PR completes that issue's acceptance criteria.

## Validation

Record the commands actually run, relevant runtime/toolchain versions and
results. Identify skipped checks, failures and checks that require hosted CI or
an unavailable capability. Link reproducible evidence; remove sensitive output.

## Compatibility and rollout

Describe affected interfaces, configuration, data formats or generated output.
State any migration, rollback, release, credential or operational gate. If none
applies, explain that briefly.

## Documentation

Link updated documentation, examples and changelog entries where appropriate,
or explain why no documentation change is needed.

## Self-review

- [ ] The diff contains only the intended changes and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Validation evidence distinguishes passes, failures, skips and unrun checks.
- [ ] Examples and attachments contain no credentials or private source records.
- [ ] Rights, attribution and generated-file reproducibility have been considered.
- [ ] Required automated checks and existing release/publication gates remain intact.
- [ ] No mandatory second-person approval or CODEOWNERS dependency is introduced.
